title: Image-to-EEG visual-response encoding
disposition_reason: A documented shared source dependency contains a complete ten-person image-to-EEG programme/scorer, but it is not a new primary runtime registration. This encoding endpoint intentionally differs from the source paper random-half endpoint and has no authentic execution or checkpoint qualification.

scientific_target.question: Can an image-based model predict every released EEG response coordinate for200 unseen concepts in each held person using only the other nine people’s training EEG?
scientific_target.known_answer: The measured full80-repeat test-image EEG mean, with17 released noise-normalized coordinates ×100 source time samples per image.
scientific_target.answer_origin: THINGS-EEG2 test recording repetitions, used solely by the protected operator scorer after all predicted blocks are admitted.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Ten people conditional on200 shared test images;1,700 response coordinates and80 repeats are not independent people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Cross-person image-to-response prediction on released transductively preprocessed EEG. Neural response reconstruction is the genuine held-target task; it does not by itself test direct interpretation of an observed neural signal.
exclusions: No paper reproduction claim: full80-repeat mean differs from author random40-repeat-half endpoint.
No native neural-observation comprehension, causal electrode physiology, raw inductive preprocessing or SOTA.

inputs: Allowed test images or fixed image features; canonical representation AlexNet ReLU7/4096, low-level bilinear RGB16×16/768.
Training EEG from other nine people only, averaged over all four repeats per16,540 training images.
Inner development has nine held-person folds and disjoint1,324 fitting/330 development concepts.
forbidden_inputs: Outer person training/query EEG, any test response/reliability value and target-derived feature/channel selection.
Query-batch fitting, cross-context state and hidden source identity lookup.
observation_contract.case_identity: Future exact opaque image/concept aliases plus source-coordinate order; each of ten subjects supplies200 query rows, with representation/low_level/response_permuted arms.
observation_contract.split: Outer held person and200 held concepts; inner held-person/concept split selects a fixed configuration, final refit uses nine-person aggregate over all1,654 training concepts. Training statistics reused unchanged at query.
observation_contract.coverage: Each F/I/fixed-reference/tuned-reference role requires30 participant×control blocks;120 study blocks total. No authentic complete arrays or executed full panel are established by the source.

primary.name: Equal-person mean Pearson correlation over all EEG coordinate/time cells
primary.aggregation: Correlate predictions with full80-repeat targets across all200 images for each of1,700 cells; mean equally across cells then ten people.
primary.rationale: Scores the complete measured neural response with fixed support instead of selecting favorable channels/times or conflating repeat reliability with performance.

secondary: Per-coordinate correlation arrays, constant prediction/target counts and paired representation-minus-control effects.
Odd/even40-repeat split-half correlations as descriptive reliability only, with no score correction.
F/I and tuned/fixed-reference comparisons on identical full output support and recorded costs.

comparators.name: Fixed centered ridge alpha1
comparators.inputs: Training-only standardized image features and nine-person EEG aggregate
comparators.procedure: Implemented prospective benchmark reference with unpenalized intercept; not the original OLS/KernelPCA recipe.

comparators.name: Tuned ridge reference
comparators.inputs: Same inputs and all nine inner-person/development-concept folds
comparators.procedure: Implemented grid[0.0001,0.01,1,100,10000], chosen by complete representation validation and same alpha across controls.

comparators.name: Low-level and response-permuted controls
comparators.inputs: RGB768 or4096 features with whole ten-exemplar concept response groups rotated
comparators.procedure: Implemented full-refit controls; preserve response coordinate vectors and do not assume guaranteed null.

nuisance_controls: Bind exact checkpoint and source feature preprocessing; a model name is not model identity.
MVNN combines training/test covariance and mixes spatial coordinates; response units are noise-normalized, not microvolts.
Rapid200ms image spacing and unavailable sequence/session IDs permit neighboring-image effects; no causal temporal interpretation.
evaluation.uncertainty: Show all ten person scores and paired control differences conditional on the shared200 images; no population interval or binary threshold is supplied by this source.
evaluation.failure_policy: Admit all120 expected blocks before protected full-study scoring. Constant prediction gets scoring0/raw undefined; any constant target makes cell/person/full primary undefined, never dropped. Reject missing/nonfinite/wrong-shaped outputs.

implementation.scorer_target: Actual held-out measured EEG waveform coordinates. Prediction/reconstruction is a valid neural target, but the scorer cannot demonstrate direct comprehension of a supplied neural observation.
implementation.delivered_scope: Full source inside shared four-programmes distribution, including original scorer and F/I modelling; current registration is a dependency, not an independently qualified runtime.
missing: Authenticate all-ten coordinates and complete source EEG/image mapping.
Bind checkpoint/features and actual numerical/container/provider environments.
Qualify complete native study and fixed/tuned reference competence.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source declares no authentic arrays, feature inference, fits, provider calls or scientific scores during construction. This revision inspected source only.

direct_observation.representation: The task gives images and withholds neural responses; revealing neural traces would change/leak its encoding target.
direct_observation.boundary: Image-only prediction could be a separate direct-model condition but is not interpretation of observed neural data.
missing: A separate measured-neural-input target is needed for direct neural interpretation.

typed_viewer.representation: Viewing held neural target waveforms is incompatible with this encoding endpoint.
typed_viewer.boundary: A stimulus-image viewer would preserve image encoding but cannot be reported as neural-observation interpretation.
missing: Define a separate neural-input assay if that ability is desired.

tool_assisted.representation: No per-query tool-assisted investigation is delivered. I inspects its own training X/Y through bounded Python tools before sealing train/query source.
tool_assisted.boundary: Fresh context per inner/final training context and arm; no query inputs/held responses during investigation; only aggregate development selection crosses contexts.
missing: Provider/tool boundaries and full input/execution qualification.
Implement a participant-facing held-query investigation condition if this capability is required; do not relabel training-only investigation as query interpretation.

frozen_program.representation: F commits complete train/query code and configuration roster before neural views.
frozen_program.boundary: Independent training and query processes; frozen model and train-only statistics; all arms complete.
missing: Actual native execution and complete checkpoint/source qualification.

Complete prospective image-to-EEG endpoint, information boundaries and explicit difference from author historical endpoint.
All1700 cell correlations over200 images, ten-person aggregation, constant-target handling and separate reliability.
Original complete source data/coordinate/exposure limitations and preserved endpoint.
Separate actor train/query execution and programme lifecycle source.

evidence.locator: Original source paper identified and pinned in the preserved registration
evidence.supports: Source recording family and experimental measurement; prospective benchmark comparisons are specified separately.
Concrete pre-neural-view F programme authoring and generated-program admission.
Concrete bounded I inspection exists only for training context; query inputs/held responses unavailable.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human outcome for this task is established by this source review. The separate four historical EEG/sleep programme attempts are not evidence for this task or its direct/viewer modes.
excluded_claims: No paper reproduction claim: full80-repeat mean differs from author random40-repeat-half endpoint.
No native neural-observation comprehension, causal electrode physiology, raw inductive preprocessing or SOTA.

summary: State that neural response prediction is legitimate but does not test neural-input direct understanding.
Preserve prospective80-repeat endpoint instead of falsely inheriting source-paper score comparability.
Expose shared-dependency status, full120-block support, and strict constant-target handling.
Count existing training-only investigation as a programme condition, not delivered per-query tool-assisted interpretation.
revision.source_review: Read original task, task README and the exact implementation/contract files listed below. Source declarations are distinguished from observed execution; primary citations reuse the preserved source audit unless the receipt explicitly records a fresh check.
